Thota Pass
Open pickup app

Know when the pickup van has left.

During coffee harvest, workers need to know whether their pickup is on its way. Thota Pass is a proposed service that sends the driver’s update by Kannada call or text before workers leave home.

Pickup updates, with or without mobile signal

For villages with mobile signal

Thota Pass app

Works on any phone with signal.

  • The estate and the driver use the app.
  • Workers with a basic phone get the update as a Kannada text and a short voice call, so no smartphone is needed.
  • Workers with a smartphone can also download the app to see the status, job details and pickup time.
Needs
Mobile signal
Cost
Included in every plan
If missed
Call back to hear the latest update
For villages with weak or no signal

Thota Buzzer

Works without a phone or signal.

  • A small radio buzzer at each worker’s home lights up green when the van leaves.
  • The light stays on until the driver changes it.
Needs
Nothing but a charged buzzer
Cost
₹1,499 per buzzer, one-time
If missed
The light is still on

A small reward for keeping workers informed

The proposed points scheme rewards drivers for timely, accurate updates. Estates would pay the rewards at the end of the season.

  • Update sent before driving+20
  • Arrived on time+20
  • Warned workers about a delay+10
  • 5 good mornings in a row+50
  • No update by 6:30−20

Questions

Do workers need a smartphone?

No. They get a Kannada text and a short voice call on any phone. With the buzzer, they don’t need a phone at all.

What if no update comes?

If there’s no update by 6:30, workers stay home. The driver loses points, not the workers.

Is Thota Pass live?

Not yet. This is a student design project for MGT 604. The pickup app runs with sample data. Alerts and payments are simulated.

Thota Pass · a student design project for coffee estates in rural Karnataka, India.
